What do you use for sifting? I'm reclaiming a massive shitty "flower bed" with "paths" made up of what looks like 1/2 gravel on top of almost 8 inches of stonedust. I can kinda seperate it just based on where I dig but there will be parts that are all mixed up.

A 2'x4' frame with legs to make it sit at a 45 degree angle, with hardware cloth inside. I just till up the area, shovel it in, then dump the screen into an area I haven't tilled. That way I can keep hitting it with the tiller to break up any dirt chunks, and at the very end of the area start dumping the remaining rocks into the discard pile.

I'm tilling in ground, not over the cloth. Once it's broken up I will sift it, and whatever didn't make it through gets dumped back to be tilled again.

Wet is not going to be your friend. It just clogs up the hardware cloth. I let mine dry out as much as I could. In one of the pics I posted you can see a strip in the back that didn't get sifted because it was too wet.

I've got the same issue with clay, with lots of sand over the top of that. It was like concrete.
